population_definition: Every incident record classified as a cyber incident affecting a covered contractor information system or the CUI it holds, within the reporting window. Incidents triaged as non-reportable remain in the population with their classification and its basis.
source_system: incident response platform joined to DIBNet submission receipts

passing.note: triaged non-reportable; classification basis recorded and retained in the population

coverage_basis: 3 of 3 incidents in the reporting window affecting a covered contractor information system or the CUI it holds. passing[] is enumerated here because the population is small and the passing set is itself the artifact an assessor asks for. INC-2026-0417 was accepted 78.3 hours after discovery against the 72-hour clause clock; the full occurrence-to-submission window was 156.6 hours, and the shorter figure is the one the clause tests.
